name: intelligence-reference-set-v3-measurements
access: SELECT only (mcp execute_sql); nothing written to production
method: tools/intelligence/reference_set_v3_measure.py prints the SELECTs (detection_sql in slices, conversion_sql). Detection = intelligence_events.raw_title ~* pattern AND published_at in [from-1d, to+2d) (the scorecard match window); first = earliest collected_at. published_at values are post the 2026-11-24 +10h RSS repair. Records absent from detection_rows matched ZERO events.
conversion_channels: events.brief_id; captains_daily_briefs.brief_text ~* pattern within [from-1d, to+7d]; intelligence_briefs.forward_watch / top_events+executive_snapshot+emerging_themes; intelligence_products body_md+summary. Pattern matching of brief text is weaker evidence than brief_id (same caveat as the scorecard).
conversion_scope: measured only for the records listed in conversion_rows (the material categories); every other record: conversion NOT MEASURED.
caveats: RS-057 first pattern also matched a CISA KEV row (published_at is a date-only placeholder 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z, collected 2026-09-08T20:00:23Z, REFERENCE); the committed pattern excludes it because its relation to the ASD alert is not verified.
RS-042#dev is informational (all lifecycle developments Jul-Oct); RS-042 is the onset window 22-24 Jul used for detection.
Google News rows often carry date-only placeholder published_at times (exact HH:00:00); first_published_at of those rows is not trusted as a report time.
